answer: I ran the 3-qubit GHZ circuit on sirius:mock with 200 shots using the helper script iqm_run.py. The circuit was H on q0, CNOT q0 to q1, CNOT q1 to q2, then a measurement of all 3 qubits. Job 01a15f3b-012c-76a9-b8cd-a99922987451 completed. The counts were {"000": 200}. The transpiled circuit had 5 r gates, 2 cz gates, 4 move gates, and 3 measurements. Sirius needs the move gates to route through its resonator. A mock backend does not simulate the circuit, so these counts do not show real GHZ behavior. A real QPU should give mostly 000 and 111. The mock run is free, and the helper estimated 0 credits. The QASM file is at /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_f3caa17a-2c4-36/ghz3.qasm.
